source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Near our house there is a bakery.

sentences.ar: كل الصبح بيطلع منه ريحة خبز.
sentences.en: Every morning the smell of bread comes out of it.
I go and buy hot bread.
The baker knows me and gives me an extra piece.
Hot bread is the nicest thing.
